## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the workflow problem it solves.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `cargo xtask ci` passes (fmt, clippy, tests, doctests)
- [ ] `cargo xtask layers` passes
- [ ] Documentation reflects behavior, limits, cost, and side effects
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, client data, local paths, or generated reports are included

## Side effects

List network requests, file writes, source mutations, provider charges, and opt-in probes. Write
`None` when the change is pure.
